The signal keeps dropping out and I'm trying to get some research done but it's almost impossible without internet access. I've tried restarting my laptop multiple times, but nothing seems to be working. Hoping this gets resolved this week so I can focus on my studies.

The food in the mess hall is really poor and the quality of the meals has been consistently bad lately. It's a minor inconvenience that affects my daily routine but it's still frustrating. This is a serious problem because I need to focus on my coursework and studying, but the constant noise is making it impossible. The damaged window latch is also allowing cold air to seep in and making my room uncomfortable. Please fix this immediately as I'm finding it really hard to concentrate and relax in such conditions.

This is medium priority because I can usually find something to eat elsewhere, but having a reliable option on campus would be nice. The electricity bill amount seems incorrect - just wanted to inform you that our room has been running pretty low on power lately and I thought we might have gotten a mistake in our calculation. It's not a huge deal or anything but whenever you get time, it would be good to have it checked out and possibly sorted. We won't lose any sleep over it but it would be nice if it got taken care of soon.

The loud music in the corridor has been like this for a few days now and it's really disrupting my sleep. The constant thumping is making it hard for me to focus on my studies and get some rest. This needs attention as it's affecting my overall stay here. I'd appreciate it if you could look into getting the noise level down, maybe by reminding residents of their quiet hours or setting up a designated music zone.

The water leakage from the bathroom ceiling is getting annoying and needs attention. Water droplets are constantly falling on my bed, making a mess and ruining my stuff. The noise from the room next door is really loud at night and makes it hard for me to sleep. The trash in the corridor has been piling up for days and it's getting gross. Honestly, this doesn't seem like a huge priority to me so whenever you get time, could we get the room cleaned up or talk about doing something to quiet the noise down? It's not killing me, I just thought I'd let you know that someone else might be affected by it.

The cupboard door won't close properly and this needs attention. It's frustrating because sometimes my food gets knocked out by mistake. I have work to do and a bit of clutter around me isn't ideal. A fix would make my room feel more organized and tidy, which is helpful for focus. It's not super urgent but it would be good if someone could look into this soon.

The bathroom tap won't stop dripping and water is constantly accumulating on the floor. It's not a big deal but it's still pretty annoying. The dripping noise is also a bit distracting when trying to study or relax in the common area. To be honest, I'm not losing sleep over it because there are more pressing issues with the hostel, so no immediate rush to fix this please just whenever you get around to it.

The room next door is extremely noisy at night and I was charged twice for mess fees, which is getting annoying. The mess doesn't have enough food options and this is really frustrating because I'm studying hard for an exam tomorrow and I need something decent to eat. It's really inconvenient that they don't have more choices, especially during peak hours when everyone wants to eat at the same time. I need this resolved ASAP so I can focus on my studies without wasting time waiting for food.

The mess and food quality are really disappointing here. The kitchen is a disaster and my meals were unappetizing. I'm trying to study but it's hard to focus on my work when everything around me is so messy. I have work to do and I need a clean and healthy environment to concentrate. This should be fixed as soon as possible, the dining hall needs an upgrade in terms of cleanliness and food quality.

I'm having some trouble with wifi in my room, and I think it's worth bringing up at your convenience. The signal is pretty weak and it's a minor inconvenience that's been going on for a while. To be honest, I don't really think this is a priority, but I thought I'd report it anyway so you're aware of the issue. If there's no immediate action needed, it would be great to have it looked at eventually, but no rush is necessary.

The internet speed is extremely slow and I was charged twice for mess fees. It's getting annoying as I need reliable access to do my college work. Please fix this soon so I can focus on my studies without distractions. The double charge is also a concern, could you look into that too?

I need this fixed before tomorrow because I'm planning to take a shower tonight and can't stand the thought of dealing with a flooded floor. The constant sound of the dripping water is really annoying too, please get someone to fix this ASAP.

This needs attention as my project deadline is looming and I'm missing out on valuable work time. I've tried restarting it but nothing seems to be working, so I thought I'd report the issue. It would be helpful if someone could take a look at it soon, preferably within the next few days.

The heater in my room isn't working which makes it really cold at night and I'm finding it hard to sleep. The bathroom tap won't stop dripping either which is annoying. Just wanted to inform you whenever you get time, it would be good to have these issues sorted out so I don't have to deal with them all the time. To be honest, they feel like low priority compared to some of the other problems we've had here recently.

The mess doesn't seem to be getting replenished as frequently as we need it to. It's been like this for a few days and some of us are struggling to find something decent to eat. This is starting to get frustrating because we all pay for our meals here. Please fix this soon, so we can actually enjoy the facilities without breaking the bank or going hungry every day.

The lack of food is causing tension among the residents and it's impacting our living experience. "There's not enough food in the mess and it's getting pretty basic. To be honest, it's not a big deal but sometimes having at least one decent meal option after a long day would be nice. It wouldn't make a huge difference, but it would be appreciated."

The lack of hot water means we have to rely on cold showers which isn't ideal, especially after a long day. This needs attention, so I hope it gets fixed soon."

"The wifi in my room hasn't been working properly and it's been like this for a few days now. I'm having some issues with my room's wifi signal and I just wanted to inform you that it's not working properly. To be honest, I think this is a relatively low priority compared to other things going on in our hostel. The internet is available from communal areas, so it's not the end of the world if I don't have it in my room at your convenience.

The study table is quite uncomfortable because it's wobbly and keeps shifting when I'm trying to study. This needs attention because it makes it hard for me to focus on my work. The hostel wifi has also been spotty all week, and it's really frustrating that I can't get a stable connection. It's not a huge priority right now, but fixing the table would be nice and getting the wifi sorted out would make studying easier.

The water leakage from the bathroom ceiling is annoying and occasionally drips down onto my floor. It's not a huge deal but just wanted to inform you that it's been going on whenever you get time, and I'm sure it'll be fine, but still thought I'd mention it. The mess can be pretty frustrating when it happens again after the initial fix.

The hostel fee bill says my monthly payment is due today but when I went to pay online, it said there's an error with my account number, which means they're not accepting my payment right now. This needs attention because it's getting annoying that every month, this mistake happens and I have to spend extra time fixing it. I'm starting to think it would be helpful if you could double check the bills before sending them out.

The food is always cold and the room next door is extremely noisy at night this is an emergency it's completely unusable because I'm trying to study and sleep in a hostel but can't do that if my food doesn't even taste good and I have to listen to the constant noise from my neighbors all night. This is high priority and needs to be fixed ASAP so we can get some actual quality of life here.

The food is always cold and it's getting annoying. Every meal seems to come out of the microwave at the same temperature, which isn't exactly appetizing. This should be fixed as a matter of priority - regular dorm food is hard enough without having to worry about scalding ourselves on every meal. I'd appreciate some effort to heat up the food properly, even if it's just a simple fix like adjusting the microwave settings or re-training the staff.

The wifi in my room has stopped working and I've been trying to contact someone about it for days. Just wanted to inform you that it's not being attended to at all and it's affecting my studies and work. The corridor router hasn't been fixed since the issue started, which means everyone on this floor is facing poor internet connectivity. It would be great if someone could look into it as soon as possible. At your convenience, I'd appreciate it if the washroom was also cleaned - it's been like that for days and it's starting to get unpleasant.

There's garbage piling up in the corridor and it's getting annoying. The mess is starting to smell and is attracting pests which isn't ideal for a place where people are staying. This needs attention so that we can all stay comfortably in our rooms without being distracted by the waste. Please clean this up as soon as possible, it would make a big difference to us residents.

I'm being charged twice for mess fees and this is an emergency because I've already paid once, which is not fair. The sink drain is blocked and water has been backing up into my room. It's been like this for a few days, which is getting frustrating. Having to go out of my way every time I need to wash something is inconvenient and not ideal. Please address this as soon as possible so we can get the room back to normal.

The wifi in my room is slow and intermittent, which makes it hard to work on group projects. It's a minor inconvenience that I've tried to ignore, but it's been really frustrating. There are other people staying here who have better connections than me, so I thought it was worth reporting the issue. To be honest, there's no immediate rush to fix this, as I can still get by with my phone's data.

The electricity bill amount seems incorrect and people are playing loud music in the corridor, making it hard for me to study at night. It's a minor inconvenience but it's still annoying. The noise issue is more of an ongoing problem so maybe we can discuss a solution for that later.

Please fix this soon so I can get a better night's sleep without worrying about the heat.

The food served in the hostel was stale and old, which is quite uncomfortable as I had been looking forward to a hot meal after a long day of classes. It's not like it was a major crisis or anything but still, having to eat cold, congealed food is really annoying. Please address this issue so that future guests don't have to go through the same thing and we can enjoy better quality food in our stay.
